notes.title: Bereaved: Soldiers of Fate is here finally!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Bereaved: Soldiers of Fate is finally here! And to make up for the wait, the game is on sale for 7 days 40% off! Took forever huh? Sorry about that, we had several issues behind the scenes that have all been resolved. We've learned a lot on how everything works, and now here we are! And one more thing, please leave any bugs you may find in our discord! We will be able to answer any question/issue instantly!



[/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/drpgf3psVX"]https://discord.com/invite/drpgf3psVX[/url][/p]

notes.title: Bereaved: Soldiers of Fate is entering early access!
notes.notes:
[p]After nearly a year, we are finally releasing our game! Albeit in early access, not exactly what we wanted, but it had to be done. This version of the game will include all of the demo's content and adding more to it, (such as new cutscenes, interactables, and npcs.) As well as the entirety of Chapter 2! Making the total playtime so far 8-10 hours! We hope you'll enjoy what we have made for you, and if you have any questions join our discord!

[url="https://discord.com/invite/drpgf3psVX"]https://discord.com/invite/drpgf3psVX[/url][/p]
